description: After the vein title button on Goals is activated, the view switches to Tasks and focus falls to <body>. Keyboard and screen-reader users lose their place.
expected: Focus moves to the Tasks nav button or the board heading (the catalog expects the pressed Tasks nav button).
suggested_fix: After showBoard(), focus the Tasks nav button (or the Vein filter that was just set).

description: "Ready for a verdict" has no tooltip or explanation. It could be read as "approved". The rule (every task ended, at least one task, no disputed status) is invisible.
expected: A title or help text: "All 3 tasks have ended. Choose Proven, Dead end or Abandoned."
suggested_fix: Add a title or aria-describedby with the rule and the next action.

criterion: Navigation: user always knows where they are
description: A vein filter set from Goals persists on the board after the user moves on. Returning to Tasks shows only that vein's tasks, and the only signal is the Vein select's value. The board looks like it is missing tasks.
expected: A visible "Filtered to vein …  ×" chip or a count of hidden tasks.
actual: Silent persistence; the other columns read "No tasks here".
suggested_fix: Show an active-filter summary with Clear above the board.

description: At 1440 px the board's Vein select truncates "Lazy-load PDF renderer" to "Lazy-load PDF rende…". The three filter selects are a fixed 190 px wide.
expected: Typical vein names fit, or the select grows.
suggested_fix: Let the Vein select size to content up to a max width.

description: Task details show "Veins: Lazy-load PDF renderer (Open)" as plain text, and board card vein labels are not links. Only the Goals title button navigates to the vein.
expected: Vein names in task details link to the vein-filtered board or the vein on Goals.
suggested_fix: Make vein names in task details buttons that call openVein.
